comment: АСТУР СПН-group thresholds (epic PRO-338, phase 3; Ф3.5). Loaded by app.config.load_astur_thresholds. v1 sliced MAX_RAW_SCORE=127 into equal percentage steps (10/30/70/90%), which implicitly assumes raw scores are UNIFORMLY distributed across the population — unrealistic for a cognitive test (scores cluster around the middle, tails are thin). v2 instead uses the score-band shape reported for the real СПН methodology (Гуревич и др., 1996; secondary citations consolidated via a 2026-09 research pass, see project ticket history) for its 5 groups (~10/20/40/20/10% of a reference population): group1 (top ~10%) starts at 75% of max, group2 (next ~20%) at 50%, group3 (middle ~40%) at 25% — these three cut points come from the source. The group4/group5 split (bottom ~20% vs ~10%, both under 25%) is NOT given an exact figure in any source found — it is our own linear interpolation of that 25% band by the 20:10 population ratio (~8.3% of max), not a sourced value. Applied to MAX_RAW_SCORE=127 (scripts/astur_bank.py's 6 scored subtests: 20+16+12+38+26+15): <=11 -> group5, <=32 -> group4, <=64 -> group3, <=95 -> group2, >95 -> group1. Still NOT a real percentile table calibrated on this platform's own users — replace with actual calibrated bounds once real user data accumulates (the office now administers this test in person, so that data will be genuine going forward).
